meta.title: Jerk Tofu & Coconut Rice & Peas
meta.subtitle: Single wok · no cornstarch · island flavors 🌴

items.name: Extra-firm tofu
items.note: Press well — dry tofu sears and glazes best

items.name: Long-grain white rice
items.note: Long-grain, NOT jasmine — holds texture for meal prep

items.name: Red kidney beans
items.note: The 'peas' in rice & peas. Drain & rinse

items.name: Scallions / green onions
items.note: 1 for the rice, extra for garnish

items.name: Scotch bonnet pepper
items.note: Left WHOLE in the rice for aroma, not heat. Habanero works too

items.name: Full-fat coconut milk
items.note: Full-fat for creaminess — the Thai-style canned kind

items.name: Wet jerk seasoning / paste
items.note: Walkerswood is the easy standard. Must be WET, not dry. It's hot!

items.name: BBQ sauce
items.note: A plain/basic one — let the jerk be the star

items.name: Vegetable broth
items.note: For the tofu marinade — may already have a carton/cube

items.name: Ground allspice (pimento)
items.note: Signature Jamaican spice — likely already in your rack
